title: Deny list
description: Customers who cannot book or collect a car

help.title: About the deny list
help.overview: A blocked email or licence number is refused when a booking is made and again at handover.

sections.title: On this page
items: Give an email, a licence number, or both.
Turn Active off to allow that customer again without deleting the row.
